units: 1 Blender unit = 1 m; Z up; front faces -Y; pivot at footprint centre, ground Z = 0; plinth to Z = -0.3
fbx: one file per mesh: an LodGroup empty <mesh> (fbx_type = LodGroup) with children <mesh>_LOD0..LOD3 (triangulated, smoothing groups, tangents, vertex colour Col); import with Import Mesh LODs

material_notes.M channel: R emissive (lit windows / lamps at night), G culture tint mask, B accent (pale gold) mask
material_notes.ORM: R ambient occlusion, G roughness, B metallic (linear)
material_notes.N: tangent space, OpenGL (+Y); flip green on UE import
material_notes.UVs: tiling world-scale UVs (not 0..1; nothing is baked) except the Tech atlas, which is region-mapped
material_notes.M_Age6_RoofMetal: same textures as M_Age6_Cladding, albedo x0.62

Default.note: white and warm-cream facades, pale gold, blue solar glass (concept age-6-space)

CliffTerrace.note: rose-ochre plaster tone, copper accents, drier planting (culture A)

LagoonWeaver.note: silver-white with saffron accents, lush aqua-green planting (culture B)

RingBuilder.note: cool pale stone, slate-blue silver accents, heather-toned planting (culture C)

launch_site_layout.note: suggested placement relative to the LaunchPad pivot (metres, yaw degrees); the rocket stands on the pad socket rocket_mount
launch_site_layout.SM_Age6_Crawlerway_Intact: chain 3 segments along -Y from the pad socket crawlerway, rotated 90
